diagnoses.description: `uv-package-manager` contains an incorrect command form for selecting a Python version. It shows `uv --python 3.11 run ...`, but `--python` is an option to `uv run` (i.e., `uv run --python 3.11 ...`). This is a concrete CLI syntax error that will fail when followed literally.

locations.section: Python Version Management / Pattern 9: Setting Python Version

diagnoses.description: `testing-python` includes highly project-specific rules (e.g., FastMCP-only guidance and a blanket ban on `@pytest.mark.asyncio` based on `asyncio_mode = "auto"`) despite being presented as a general Python testing skill. This can mislead users working on repositories that do not use FastMCP or do not have global `asyncio_mode=auto` configured.

`analyze-ci` has an internal inconsistency between the declared `allowed-tools` command pattern and the documented usage. Frontmatter restricts usage to `uv run skills analyze-ci:*` while the Usage section instructs `uv run skills analyze-ci <pr_url>` (no `:*`). This mismatch can cause tool invocation confusion/failure under enforcement.
